thesis: The page is a Minnesota wall being sided: every section is a 7-inch lap course nailed over the last, and scrolling covers each nail line as the wall goes from bare studs to trim.

signature.name: Lap Course + Nail Line
signature.summary: Every band is a lap course: a 7-inch (scaled, --course) rhythm, a drip-shadow line that falls under the course above, and a row of nail-head dots at its top edge that the next course slides over and hides as you scroll. Hero: a 6/12-pitch gable mask, left half duotone photo, right half the drawn wall section that builds studs → sheathing → wrap → flashing → starter → courses. Layers story: 7 courses stack, one per layer. Proof: reviews and prices sit on courses with nail-head bullets. Footer: the top course capped by a trim board. Hook: data-sw-signature on every course band.

palette.family: Sheathing Charcoal + Housewrap Frost + Ember Window

layoutMoves: every section is a horizontal course band with a left 'course number' gutter (C-01…C-12) in mono
the hero is a rambler gable at 6/12 pitch (26.57deg rake) used as a shape mask: the left half shows the duotone photo, the right half is the drawn wall section, the h1 sits under the eave line
layers story is a vertical stack of 7 courses that pins at ≥ 640px and stacks with clip reveals below
prices are a course board: each range is one lap board with its exposure in inches as the row height
areas + ZIP checker sit on the starter strip at the bottom of the wall before the footer trim

motion.intro: ≤ 1.1 s: the gable mask draws its rake from eave to ridge while the drawn half builds bottom-up (studs, sheathing, wrap, flashing, starter, 3 courses) at 90ms per layer; text is in the DOM from frame 0, click/scroll/key skips to end.
stories: stack: #layers pins (7 × 55svh + 100svh) and sets one course per step from the bottom, its drip-shadow falling 6px into place and the nail dots of the course below scaling to 0
draw: the reveal visualizer redraws the wall's course lines when the exposure changes (4 / 5 / 7 in., Dutch lap, board and batten)
motion.hover: a 2px ember hairline slides in under the item from the left (scaleX 0→1, 200ms), like a chalk line snapped
